data.body:
Premise CONFIRMED in code: `explain_material_change` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/material_diff.py) emitted CHECKBOX_NOTE on only the 'no material component differs' branch and the degraded pre-component-hashing branch; the primary `delta is not None` early return — the branch a CURRENT attestation takes — returned the named delta with no note.

Fix pushed as Gerrit change 1637 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1637), message-text only:
- AC1: the named-delta branch now appends the same CHECKBOX_NOTE.
- AC2: a diagnostic, non-basis `description_boxes` component (checkbox-state hash + ticked count) rides alongside the existing `material-part:` lines, so when `description` changed the message says 'its TEXT changed, checkbox state is unchanged' or 'its TEXT changed, and checkbox state changed too (0 -> 2 ticked), which is NOT the cause'. It is absent from COMPONENT_ORDER, so the composite fingerprint and describe_delta ignore it — no gate outcome can change. Pre-diagnostic attestations get no clause rather than a guess.
- AC3: held-out tests in tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py cover tick-only (no staleness), AC-text edit (stale + note + 'checkbox state is unchanged'), text+ticks (both separated), and the degraded no-clause path.

Local gates: 189 plan_review tests pass, make lint and make typecheck clean, module 407 LOC (cap 800).
